title: How AI-Powered Medical Record Review Helps Insurers Evaluate Injury Claim Demand Packages
summary: Learn how AI-powered medical record review helps insurers organize, summarize, and validate injury claim demand packages while preserving human decision authority.
body_markdown:
**Article summary:** *Injury claim demand packages are becoming larger, more detailed, and more strategically constructed as plaintiff attorneys use extensive medical documentation, polished damages narratives, higher settlement anchors, and advanced litigation strategies. This article explains how AI-powered medical record review helps insurers organize, extract, summarize, and validate information in those packages. By turning large sets of unstructured medical records into structured, source-linked information, the technology can reduce time spent searching documents, support more consistent reviews, and help claim professionals focus on evaluation and negotiation while retaining decision authority.*


**


Injury claim demand packages are becoming larger, more detailed, and more strategically constructed. Plaintiff attorneys increasingly support demands with extensive medical documentation, polished damages narratives, higher settlement anchors, and advanced litigation strategies. At the same time, insurers are operating in an environment shaped by rising litigation costs, third-party litigation funding, and larger jury awards. Together, these factors can increase the complexity and financial exposure associated with bodily injury claims.


For claim professionals, the challenge is no longer simply reviewing records. It is quickly separating documented facts from advocacy, understanding the full medical narrative, identifying pre-existing or unrelated conditions, validating whether the treatment and damages presented are supported by the record, and preparing for negotiation with confidence. Demand packages may contain hundreds or thousands of pages spanning multiple providers, treatment dates, and document types.


AI-powered medical record review can make that information easier to use. It processes unstructured documents, extracts relevant medical details, organizes them into a reviewable structure, and links findings back to source pages. The result is a clearer starting point for claim professionals, not an automated claim decision.


## What is demand package review?


Demand package review is the process of organizing, analyzing, and validating the medical and claim information submitted to support an injury settlement demand.


For insurers, an effective review helps claim professionals understand treatment history, identify relevant and unrelated conditions, assess whether documentation supports the presented damages, and prepare for evaluation and negotiation.


## Why are injury claim demand packages difficult to review?


The sophistication of today’s demand packages increases the review burden. Claim professionals must evaluate both the supporting record and the narrative built around it, reconstruct the medical chronology, connect details across providers, distinguish loss-related treatment from unrelated history, and identify missing or inconsistent context.


Review becomes more difficult when records include pre-existing conditions, multiple injuries, gaps in treatment, duplicate pages, inconsistent terminology, or scanned material of varying quality. Differences in experience and review practices can also lead people to organize or interpret the same file differently.


When claims teams are already managing heavier workloads and experienced-talent constraints, manual review can consume hours, delay evaluation, and leave less time for assessment and negotiation.


## How does AI-powered medical record review work?


AI-powered medical record review processes a document set and presents relevant information in a structured form. Instead of searching page by page, a claim professional can begin with an organized view of the file and trace extracted information back to the original record.


The technology can support several steps in the review process:


- Ingest and process medical records and other claim documents.
- Identify and extract diagnoses, medications, comorbidities, procedures, providers, dates of service, and other relevant terms.
- Organize findings by date, provider, and document type.
- Generate high-level summaries and chronological views.
- Extract key information to help support decisions.
- Identify duplicate content and help create a cleaner record set.
- Link findings to supporting source pages for validation.
- Provide search and tagging tools to locate relevant medical information.


These capabilities help reduce administrative work while keeping interpretation, evaluation, and claim decisions with the claim professional.


## How can insurers deploy demand package review capabilities?


AI-powered demand package review capabilities can help insurers organize, extract, summarize, and validate information contained in injury claim demand packages. These capabilities support the review of large medical record files by creating a more structured, traceable view of the information submitted in support of a claim.


Verisk's Discovery Navigator provides the AI-powered medical record review capabilities that help insurers organize, extract, summarize, and validate information in injury claim demand packages. Insurers can use Discovery Navigator as a standalone solution or access these embedded capabilities as Demand Package Review within Liability Navigator, where they support a broader bodily injury claim evaluation workflow.


Discovery Navigator uses AI-assisted document processing and generative AI summarization to extract, organize, and summarize information from unstructured medical records. Users can navigate from summarized findings back to supporting source pages and incorporate the solution into existing workflows through portal, SFTP, or API connectivity.


## What should insurers look for in a medical record review solution?


Core features matter, but usability, governance, and workflow fit determine whether a solution can support claim operations in practice. Insurers should evaluate the following criteria:


- **Traceability:** Can users connect each summarized or extracted point to the supporting source page?
- **Relevant structure:** Is information organized around dates, providers, diagnoses, treatments, and other claim-relevant concepts?
- **Workflow fit:** Can the solution connect with current systems and intake processes without adding unnecessary steps?
- **Configurability:** Can outputs reflect the organization’s templates, review standards, and use cases?
- **Human oversight:** Does the technology support professional judgment rather than replace it?
- **Security and governance:** Are appropriate controls in place for sensitive claim and medical information?


## How can AI-powered demand package review support claim teams?


A structured, source-linked review can help claim teams spend less time searching records, apply a more consistent review approach, and prepare more effectively for evaluation and negotiation. It can also make it easier to identify treatment history, pre-existing or unrelated conditions, duplicate records, gaps in care, and other context that requires professional review.


The goal is not automated claim decision-making. The goal is to give claim professionals clearer, more usable information so they can apply their expertise efficiently and consistently.


## Frequently asked questions about AI medical record review


**Does AI replace the claim professional in demand package review?**


No. AI-powered review organizes and summarizes information to support the claim professional. The claim professional remains responsible for validating the record, applying judgment, and making claim decisions.


**Can users verify AI-generated findings?**


A source-linked solution allows users to navigate from a summarized or extracted finding to the supporting page in the original record. This traceability supports validation and review.


**What information can medical record review technology extract?**


Depending on the solution and file, extracted information may include diagnoses, medications, comorbidities, procedures, providers, dates of service, and other relevant medical terms.


**How is Demand Package Review related to Discovery Navigator and Liability Navigator?**


Discovery Navigator provides the AI-powered medical record review capabilities that help insurers organize, extract, summarize, and validate information contained in injury claim demand packages. Organizations can implement these capabilities as a standalone solution through Discovery Navigator or access Demand Package Review functionality within Liability Navigator as part of a broader bodily injury claim evaluation workflow.


**Can AI-powered medical record review integrate with claims workflows?**


Discovery Navigator supports portal, SFTP, and API connectivity, allowing insurers to use the solution through different operating models.


**What is the main benefit of using AI for demand package review?**


The primary benefit is a faster, more structured starting point for review. Claim professionals can spend less time locating information and more time validating findings, evaluating the claim, and preparing for settlement discussions.
